positions.title: Career Services Advisor
positions.description:
•	Provide attentive customer service in the career office serving 3,600+ students
•	Assess students’ needs and provide personalized strategies and advice in career development topics including resumes, cover letters, job search, networking, and interviewing
•	Review and edit student documents; provide constructive feedback to maximize impact

positions.title: Design Lab Collaborator
positions.description: Communicated with regional hub coordinators, NGOs representatives and young active members of the Arts, Culture and Conflict Transformation (ACCT) community in 2 continents through online meetings to identify their needs and strengths. Used Design Lab strategies and worked collaboratively with a team of 15 to develop creative and realistic approaches to support youth leadership in the ACCT field.

positions.title: Student Ambassador
positions.description:
•	Assessed, improved and developed community-building and cultural programming for international students
•	Provided attentive customer service as the first point of contact; effectively responded to in-person, phone call and email inquiries 
•	Organized and updated students’ database and Google Sheets file for office applications in a fast-paced environment; managed office correspondence and scheduled appointments for staff members

positions.title: Brandeis University Representative
positions.description:
•	Co-lead conversations between business influencers from Forbes 500 companies and millennials from 40+ states to change the conversation about the millennial generation
•	Design a comprehensive recruiting process for Brandeis undergraduates based in core values and mission
•	Interview candidates and collaboratively review application materials 
•	Design and execute a marketing campaign via email, Facebook and in-print media to promote NMC and its work to the Brandeis community

positions.title: Strategy Intern
positions.description:
•	Created the strategy and tactics for a multimillion-dollar campaign to increase colorectal cancer screening among POC, pitched strategy to FCB’s CEO, CCO and the client
•	Collaborated with a group of 9 interns across departments as the strategy leader for the creative execution of the campaign
•	Conducted market research, designed and led user interviews, and identified consumer insights to formulate the strategy
•	Organized tactical and consumer insight research following file organization protocols for a portfolio of brands, identified key research information, and presented a collection of research guides to leadership

positions.title: Digital Marketing Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed creative content and scripts to introduce a new financial service to the Ecuadorian market; first storyboard proposal resulted in the client’s request to increase the initial order
•	Analyzed data and trends to design a social media strategy for a tech firm that sells Salesforce, and Google products in Latin America; created 39 social media posts across LinkedIn, Facebook and Twitter for 9K followers

positions.title: Corporate Strategy and Management Intern
positions.description:
• Formulated case-studies about 3 superfoods in the US market to develop growth strategies that increased sales and clients’ response rate 
• Co-authored copywriting and liaised with the design team to produce corporate slide decks that facilitated partnerships
• Researched the Yerba Mate industry to build a database with the world’s top distributors, exporters, and producers

positions.title: Marketing Intern
positions.description:
•	Quantified and analyzed consumer behavior and geodemographic patterns using invoices collected over 12 months 
•	Organized the data according to neighborhoods in Quito and created a physical and updatable map that showed the different trends 
•	Presented suggestions for future marketing efforts and campaigns and created an Excel report

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science and Business with minors in Psychology and CAST

volunteerExperiences.description:
Volunteered as a Mentor in GWC’s six-month long Virtual Mentoring program.
Mentors met monthly with a cohort of women and nonbinary individual between
the ages of 18-26. Helped guide discussions and activities focused on
professional and educational growth in the following topics: networking best
practices, setting SMART goals, effective job searching, and how to advocate for
oneself in professional spaces.

projects.title: IMPACT Design Lab: Planning for Youth Leadership in the Emerging IMPACT Platform
projects.description: Engaged with young active members of the Arts, Culture and Conflict Transformation (ACCT) community from across the globe through online meetings to converse about their strengths and needs. Used Design Lab strategies and worked collaboratively to develop creative and realistic approaches to support youth leadership in the ACCT field.
